description: Offline normalization of verified California CDSS childcare selected rows into internal source candidates with split postal fields and explicit temporal, address, identity, and geocode gaps.
redirect_policy: Offline only; independently verified acquired input inside datahub.
retry: No automatic retry or source repull. Preserve the acquired release for explicit offline reuse.
checkpoint: Deterministic source-candidate projection, quarantine and exact row conservation; manifest written last before atomic immutable publication and independent replay.
idempotency: Release-scoped source IDs bind resource ID, DataStore row ID, acquired release and transformation version.
cancellation: Cooperative bounded replay; no network or source mutation.
retention_profile: Internal source candidates only. Preserve publisher status/dates and selected fields; split ZIP5/ZIP4; null geocodes; no inferred site, ownership, network, identity, current operation, USPS validity, or ZCTA membership.
